test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

A brave fight was put up by the cancer patient and she finally won the battle.

options.text: A brave fight had been put up by the cancer patient and she finally won the battle.
A brave fight was being put up by the cancer patient and she finally won the battle.
The cancer patient had put up a brave fight and she finally won the battle.
The cancer patient put up a brave fight and she finally won the battle.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The cancer patient put up a brave fight and she finally won the battle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Past Simple tense.
 
• The Past Simple in the passive voice has the following form: **Subject + was/were + past participle + by object__**
 
• The Past Simple in the active voice has the following form: **__Subject + past participle + object__**
 __
 
• Passive: *A large house was built by him.*
 
• Active: *He built a large house.*
 
 
 
• In the active voice of the Past Simple, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *The cancer patient put up a brave fight and she finally won the battle.*
